evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The chiasmus frames an unrehearsed rollback as effectively nonexistent — urgency-as-worry delivered through a stark either-or construction, registering alarm rather than calm policy statement.
Plain scheduling assertion with no affective intensification — settled, satisfied registration of a decided cadence.
Flat ownership attribution with no arousal markers — calm, settled assignment of responsibility.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityAsNonexistent
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker converting a preparedness gap into an existential claim — treating an unrehearsed capability as effectively absent — to register urgency?
